review.observation: Full-body small figure achieves the wide shot. Face/compass cannot be inspected. A new huge arched greenhouse and bed layout replace the hero nook.
Original SDXL hero reused without another run. It is a face-and-hands crop rather than a waist-up medium.
Face close-up visually matches the hero nose, brows, hair and lips better than SDXL; this is visual review, not biometric verification. Background is too defocused to verify the set.

Dark bob and yellow hood clearly present. Face hidden; compass appears as a new hinged-lid object. Rainy glass, ferns and wet wooden table match visible set motifs. Right foreground rather than requested left.
Top-down macro contains only hands and compass. Black/brass case and white rose persist, but new green arrow needles replace the hero dial design. No face or greenhouse geometry to verify.
Same apparent woman, dark bob, yellow coat and brown satchel in a strong upward view. Compass reverse side is visible; its dial cannot be verified. Rainy panes, roof and potting-table motifs remain.
